text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"...Like this, I can't...
look anyone in the eye."

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Even though someone like me actually has people cheering for them.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
...Guess this really is as good as I'm gonna get.
Maybe I can't improve anymore.
choice_data_list: Don't worry, you can become much stronger.
It's okay, you can become even stronger
Then, are you going to give up?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
...Guess this really is as good as I'm gonna get.
Maybe I can't improve anymore.
choice_data_list: Don't worry, you can become much stronger.
It's okay, you can become even stronger
Then, are you going to give up?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
If we get our hopes up unnecessarily,
it'll only end up hurting both me and you, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Even so, can you state it for certain?
That I can become strong.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Take responsibility and make me stronger.
No matter how tough it gets, I'll give it my all.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Will you help me become someone... who can live up to your expectations?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Yeah... Thanks!
I won't forget what you said.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
choice_data_list: You can't do it, can you?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry, I'm...
just a totally hopeless idiot.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
I should have known all along.
Even though I knew I could never just give up on it anyway.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Trainer...
I want one more chance.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
I'm... nowhere near ready
to give up yet!
choice_data_list: Let's keep moving forward, one step at a time!
